connector: bottrading.net TradingView MCP, 84 installed tools; no tool-level restriction on relevant research reads

marketBenchmarks.limits: Snapshot price performance, possibly including current session; not a total-return backtest series

financialStatements.route: TradingView symbol Financials pages, supported financial Pine fields, issuer IR filings
financialStatements.limits: Per-company/account availability. No dedicated full-statement MCP endpoint verified. Do not save Pine scripts without specific need/authorization.

news.route: TradingView symbol news pages and opened issuer/EGX/credible news sources
news.limits: Page reachable; not proof of complete headline/body access. No dedicated news MCP tool. Follow and read dated articles before claims.

majorShareholders.route: Issuer ownership/governance disclosures and EGX filings
majorShareholders.limits: TradingView COMI ownership page fetch failed. No verified ownership MCP tool. Free float is not a shareholder register; a majority shareholder may not exist.

studiesPineAndStrategies.limits: Strategy trades/equity are simulation outputs, not exchange trade counts/company equity

depthAndExchangeTradeCounts.limits: Do not infer availability from tool name; account/exchange entitlements apply

technicalRatings.route: app/collect-facts.mjs -> market_facts -> immutable research context fundamentals.values
technicalRatings.coverage: 262/296 daily and weekly ratings at verification; 260 relative volume
technicalRatings.limits: Provider snapshots may include forming daily/weekly bars. Correlated measures, not independent votes or orders.

analystConsensus.limits: Separate broker consensus from technical ratings. NoRating is unavailable; consensus update date, contributor count and target horizon remain unverified. Not an approved execution target.
